title: PD-L1 22C3 LDT on Dako automate
author: Marius MI Ilié
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iw9cfh6

steps.title: Prepare Specimens
steps.instruction: Section specimens and store them on glass slides.

substeps.instruction: Section specimens at a thickness of 3-μm.
Store slides at 4°C within 3 days after sectioning.

steps.title: Perform Deparaffinization and Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform deparaffinization, rehydration, and antigen retrieval using the PT Link (Dako PT100).

substeps.instruction: Use EnVision™ FLEX Target Retrieval Solution, low pH 6.0.

steps.title: Block Peroxidase and Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Block peroxidase and incubate specimens with the primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Perform FLEX peroxidase block for 5 minutes.
Incubate with primary mouse monoclonal antibody anti-PD-L1 (Ref. M365329, Dako) at a concentration of 1:50 for 60 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Apply Linker and Visualization Reagent
steps.instruction: Incubate specimens with the linker and HRP visualization reagent.

substeps.instruction: Incubate with EnVision™ FLEX+ Mouse LINKER for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate with EnVision™ FLEX HRP visualization reagent for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Develop Chromogen and Counterstain
steps.instruction: Develop the reaction product and finalize the slides.

steps.title: Include Controls
steps.instruction: Include the following controls in each IHC run:

substeps.instruction: Negative antibody control: buffer, no primary antibody.
